summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of POSEIDON UX improvements. All requested features are working correctly: Time Entry page with kebab menu, status indicators, week submission, and history tab; Validation page with filters, user grouping, bulk selection, and audit history; Projects page with context menu (Modifier, Pause, Terminer, Archiver, Supprimer).
